title: Okvorado — Par exportateur
description: Fiche équipement (réplique la fiche 'Inventory > Device' de NetFlow Analyzer) : résumé SNMP-like, trafic Max/Avg/Volume, interfaces avec bascule IN/OUT/Utilisation, flux reçus vs rejetés, applications, conversations, QoS. Filtre $exporter (sélection unique, arrivée par drill-down depuis l'accueil ou le Network Snapshot via var-exporter).

list.name: exporter
list.label: Exportateur
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ExporterName FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) ORDER BY ExporterName

panels.title: Résumé — interfaces déclarées (SNMP)
panels.description: Équivalent 'Device Summary' de NetFlow Analyzer : nom d'interface, description, vitesse déclarée (IfSpeed, Mbps), limite (IfBoundary). Vient de la table 'exporters' (SNMP), pas des flux — donc disponible même sans trafic récent sur l'interface.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    IfName,
    IfDescription,
    IfSpeed,
    IfBoundary,
    IfConnectivity,
    IfProvider
FROM exporters
WHERE ExporterName = '$exporter'
ORDER BY IfName
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Trafic — Max Speed / Avg Speed / Volume
Max Speed
panels.description: Débit crête sur des buckets de 1 minute (toStartOfMinute), sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 60 — comme la ligne 'Max Speed' de la fiche Traffic de NetFlow Analyzer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(debit_min) AS max_speed
FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeReceived) AS minute, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / 60 AS debit_min
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
    GROUP BY minute
)

panels.title: Avg Speed
panels.description: Débit moyen sur la période — sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / durée_s de la fenêtre.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS avg_speed
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter'

panels.title: Volume
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) sur la période sélectionnée.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter'

panels.title: Trafic dans le temps — $exporter
panels.description: sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) pour l'exportateur sélectionné, débit en bps (Mbps/Kbps affichés automatiquement par Grafana selon l'échelle).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
    InIfName AS interface,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "débit"
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
GROUP BY time, interface
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Interfaces — Volume | Débit | Utilisation, bascule IN / OUT
Interfaces IN — Utilisation (%)
panels.description: Débit IN (InIfName) ramené à InIfSpeed (Mbps mesuré sur ce ClickHouse → converti en bps). Équivalent onglet 'Utilization' + bascule 'IN' de la fiche Interface NetFlow Analyzer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    InIfName AS interface,
    least(
        100,
        (sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1))
        / (greatest(any(InIfSpeed), 1) * 1000000) * 100
    ) AS utilisation_in
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
    AND InIfName != ''
GROUP BY InIfName
ORDER BY utilisation_in DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Interfaces OUT — Utilisation (%)
panels.description: Débit OUT (OutIfName) ramené à OutIfSpeed. Bascule 'OUT' du même écran NetFlow Analyzer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    OutIfName AS interface,
    least(
        100,
        (sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1))
        / (greatest(any(OutIfSpeed), 1) * 1000000) * 100
    ) AS utilisation_out
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
    AND OutIfName != ''
GROUP BY OutIfName
ORDER BY utilisation_out DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Interfaces — tableau Volume / Débit / Utilisation IN et OUT
panels.description: Le tableau de valeurs sous les jauges d'utilisation (constante n°2). Colonnes : Interface Name / IN Traffic / OUT Traffic (volume), Speed IN/OUT (débit), Utilisation IN/OUT (%) — synthèse complète de l'onglet Interface.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    interface,
    sum(vol_in) AS volume_in,
    sum(vol_out) AS volume_out,
    sum(vol_in) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_in,
    sum(vol_out) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1) AS debit_out,
    least(100, (sum(vol_in) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1)) / (greatest(max(vitesse_in_if), 1) * 1000000) * 100) AS utilisation_in,
    least(100, (sum(vol_out) * 8 / greatest(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime), 1)) / (greatest(max(vitesse_out_if), 1) * 1000000) * 100) AS utilisation_out
FROM (
    SELECT
        InIfName AS interface,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS vol_in,
        0 AS vol_out,
        any(InIfSpeed) AS vitesse_in_if,
        0 AS vitesse_out_if
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter' AND InIfName != ''
    GROUP BY interface
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        OutIfName AS interface,
        0 AS vol_in,
        sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS vol_out,
        0 AS vitesse_in_if,
        any(OutIfSpeed) AS vitesse_out_if
    FROM flows
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter' AND OutIfName != ''
    GROUP BY interface
)
GROUP BY interface
ORDER BY volume_in DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Flow Details — flux reçus vs rejetés
Flux reçus vs rejetés dans le temps
panels.description: Équivalent de la bascule 'Received Flows | Dropped Flows' de NetFlow Analyzer. ForwardingStatus encodé en classes IPFIX (RFC 7270) : classe = intDiv(ForwardingStatus, 64), 2 = 'Dropped/Rejetés', sinon 'Reçus'. count() jamais mis à l'échelle — c'est un comptage de flux observés, pas un volume.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
    multiIf(intDiv(ForwardingStatus, 64) = 2, 'Rejetés', 'Reçus') AS statut,
    count() AS flux
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
GROUP BY time, statut
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Moyenne des flux rejetés
panels.description: Average Dropped Flows — moyenne par intervalle de la série ci-dessus.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(intDiv(ForwardingStatus, 64) = 2) AS flux_rejetes
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter'

panels.title: Dernier flux rejeté
panels.description: Last Dropped Flow — horodatage du plus récent flux au statut rejeté.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT maxIf(TimeReceived, intDiv(ForwardingStatus, 64) = 2) AS dernier_flux_rejete
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName = '$exporter'

links.title: Voir cette application dans Applications & QoS

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 443 OR SrcPort = 443), 'HTTPS',
        Proto = 6 AND (DstPort = 80 OR SrcPort = 80), 'HTTP',
        Proto = 17 AND (DstPort = 53 OR SrcPort = 53), 'DNS',
        Proto = 6, 'TCP autre',
        Proto = 17, 'UDP autre',
        Proto = 1, 'ICMP',
        'Autre'
    ) AS application,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
GROUP BY application
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: QoS — $exporter
panels.description: DSCP = bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) — jamais l'opérateur >>, refusé par ClickHouse (Code: 62 SYNTAX_ERROR, mesuré).

links.title: Voir la QoS dans Applications & QoS

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 0, 'BE',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 8, 'CS1',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 10, 'AF11',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 16, 'CS2',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 18, 'AF21',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 24, 'CS3',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 26, 'AF31',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 32, 'CS4',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 34, 'AF41',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 40, 'CS5',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 46, 'EF',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 48, 'CS6',
        bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2) = 56, 'CS7',
        concat('DSCP ', toString(bitShiftRight(IPTos, 2)))
    ) AS classe_dscp,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
GROUP BY classe_dscp
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top conversations — $exporter
panels.description: SrcAddr/DstAddr démappées (IPv6NumToString, jamais cutIPv6 qui TRONQUE — mesuré). sum(Bytes * SamplingRate), LIMIT 25. Colonne 'source' cliquable : dataLink vers le dashboard Applications & QoS filtré sur ce même exportateur (drill-down).

links.title: Voir les applications & QoS de cet exportateur

value.title: Voir cette IP source dans Anomalies
Voir cette IP destination dans Anomalies

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS source,
    replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS destination,
    DstPort AS port_destination,
    sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS volume,
    sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS paquets,
    count() AS flux
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)
    AND ExporterName = '$exporter'
GROUP BY SrcAddr, DstAddr, DstPort
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 25
